name: Be-reave ~Primary~
source:
A collection of short unrelated H-AVG stories, each drawn by different artists. You start out with 3 stories to choose from. More stories may be unlocked as you complete the stories first available to you. Though the length of each story is pretty short, there are many crossroads to be made that do have an impact on the flow of the story, unlocking various events and scenes and perhaps even multiple endings. There is more to each story than meets the eye. After you complete each story, a green bar will show how much of that story you have covered, giving you an indicator of something you may have missed.

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=210]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
本作收录了若干互不相关的短篇成人AVG故事，每篇均由不同画师绘制。开始时可从3篇故事中选择；完成最初开放的故事后，还能解锁更多内容。虽然每篇篇幅都很短，却包含许多会影响剧情走向的分支选择，能够解锁各种事件、场景，甚至多个结局。每个故事都不像表面看起来那么简单。完成一篇故事后，绿色进度条会显示探索比例，提示玩家是否还有遗漏内容。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=210]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
